target.label: TARGET
target.description: this fork's testing branch: mixed inbound + mieru outbound

official.label: REF-OFFICIAL
official.description: official mieru 3.38.1 client daemon; local SOCKS5 entry

server.label: official-SDK server harness
server.description: the same apis/server entry point mita uses, plus the minimal SOCKS5 request and UDP relay; mita itself has no Windows build

client_harness.description: scripts/mieru-bench/client: starts local TCP/UDP echo targets and drives them through the variant's SOCKS5 entry

not_comparable.rss: the target process also contains the sing-box core and a mixed inbound; the official process is a dedicated client. RSS is reported as product-level, never as adapter memory.
not_comparable.cpu: process CPU includes the whole product; CPU/GiB is reported for throughput modes only and is not an encryption-cost measurement.
not_comparable.server: the official server is the SDK entry point, not the mita binary; the server side is identical for both client variants, so it cancels in the client comparison.
not_comparable.throughput: application payload bytes on loopback; wire bytes and framing overhead are not included.
